newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Moody's says reviews Bank Austria, Creditanstalt.
newsitem.headline: Moody's says reviews Bank Austria, Creditanstalt.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Thursday it had placed Bank Austria's long-term "Aaa" deposit rating under review for a possible downgrade and Creditanstalt's A1 long-term deposit rating under review for a possible upgrade.

The statement, faxed to Reuters in Vienna, came a day after Bank Austria said it's supervisory board had voted to make a bid for arch-rival Creditanstalt, the Austrian government's privatisation candidate.
Moody's added the "Aaa" debt rating of the City of Vienna, which provides a deficiency guarantee to the bank, was also under review for a possible downgrade.
The rating agency confirmed Bank Austria's Prime-1 short term deposit rating and its C+ financial strength rating.
